observations.behavior: The strip_credentials function returns None for URLs where a credential cannot be safely distinguished from other URL components.

observations.posthog_connection: Changes repository naming behavior to never use a sanitized URL containing credentials as its identifier, reducing risk of accidental secret exposure in diagnostics.
